resolution.question: Will the listed firm Aldergate Rail warn the market about its signaling-contract delay before its scheduled interim results day on November 5?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-05T07:00:00+00:00, Aldergate Rail issues a public warning to the market about the signaling-contract delay (e.g., via a regulatory filing, press release, or stock exchange announcement). Otherwise resolve NO.
